_about: Shared cases for the timeline year reader. video-engine/src/text.ts extractTimeline (what the Timeline component draws) and its Python twin modules/graphic_recipes.timeline_dates must agree on every case: dates = the markers in order (max 5), years = their distinct years, timeline = the director may pick the timeline recipe (>= min_years distinct years). Checked by tests/test_graphic_recipes.py and video-engine/tests/text-cases.test.mts.

cases.name: two plain years
cases.text: The lighthouse was built in 1899 and automated in 1971.

cases.name: no year
cases.text: The keepers vanished without a trace.

cases.name: same year twice
cases.text: In 1900 they left. By the end of 1900 nobody knew why.

cases.name: month and day are one date
cases.text: On December 26, 1900 the relief boat arrived; in 1900 the log went quiet.

cases.name: decades
cases.text: Through the 1950s and the 1960s the station was modernised.

cases.name: thousands separator is not a year
cases.text: The storm moved 1,900 tons of rock in 1899.

cases.name: quantities are not years
cases.text: They walked 1500 miles with 1200 soldiers in 1812.

cases.name: years ago is not a year
cases.text: Some 1900 years ago Romans came; in 1066 the Normans did.

cases.name: out of range
cases.text: From 0999 to 2100 nothing counts, but 2024 and 1000 do.

cases.name: cue tags are stripped
cases.text: [MUSIC:story_low] In 1899 it was lit. [PAUSE:1.0] By 1900 it was dark. [SFX:boom]

cases.name: cap of five markers
cases.text: Jan 1900 aside: January 1900, February 1900, March 1900, April 1900, May 1900 and June 1900 came before 1901.

cases.name: month names are case-insensitive
cases.text: In MARCH 1912 and in april 1913 the ships sailed.

cases.name: percent is not a year
cases.text: Unemployment hit 1920 percent — no, in 1920 it hit 20 percent, and in 1921 more.

cases.name: non-breaking space counts as whitespace
cases.text: On December 26, 1900 it went dark; 1901 miles away nothing moved, and 1902 passed.
